newsitem.title: USA: Bindley Western acquires Tennesse drug co.
newsitem.headline: Bindley Western acquires Tennesse drug co.

text.p: Bindley Western Industries Inc said Thursday it has acquired substantially all of the operating assets and assumed most of the liabilities and contractual obligations of Tennessee Wholesale Drug Co Inc.
The acquisition, made for an undisclosed amount of cash, should be accretive from the date of closing, Bindley Western said.

Tennessee Wholesale is a full-line, full-service wholesale drug company, based in Nashville. Tennessee Wholesale had fiscal year ended March 31, 1997 sales of $308 million, employs about 130 people, and operates distribution centers in Baltimore, Nashville, and Tampa.

"With approximately 90 percent of Tennessee Wholesale's revenues coming from managed care customers, it fits very nicely with our strategic goal of significantly increasing our market share in this segment," Keith Burks, president of Bindley Western Drug Co, said in a news release.
Bindley Western shares were down 1/8 at 22-7/8 Thursday.
